mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id, m.room_id, m.sender_id, m.file_name, m.file_url, m.file_size, m.content, m.created_at, m.is_read, m.is_deleted, m.deleted_at FROM messages m WHERE m.room_id = #{room_id} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages ( room_id, sender_id, content, file_name, file_url, file_size, created_at, is_read ) VALUES ( #{room_id}, #{sender_id}, #{content}, #{file_name}, #{file_url}, #{file_size}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
